shorts.title: GTA 6: Save $5,000 Before Chapter 1 Ends
shorts.description:
When GTA 6's Chapter 1 ends, guides say you lose pocket cash, checking and your stash, but BuckMe Family Savings carries over (up to $5,000). Weapons, clothes and tattoos carry over too.
Did you save yours? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts

shorts.title: GTA 6: 3 Early Mistakes That Cost You Money
shorts.description:
Don't carry all your cash in GTA 6 (dying or getting arrested can cost you), check cars for a tracker or alarm before stealing, and use your BuckMe account as soon as it unlocks.
Which one got you? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts

shorts.title: GTA 6: Can You Miss Stuff Forever?
shorts.description:
Guides say nothing needed for 100% completion in GTA 6 is missable, at most one trophy might be, and you can finish everything in free roam after the story.
Completionist or story first? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts
